products.title: Wingspan – Pocket Edition
products.body_html:
A lighter, swifter version of the award-winning Wingspan.

Wingspan Pocket distills the Wingspan experience down to a lighter, shorter, card-driven game that has each player activate a single row of cards on each of their turns. The cards are all double sided: a food side and a bird side. Bird powers are primarily indicated by icons instead of text, and they include a new type of power, ongoing (green) benefits.

Wingspan Pocket is designed to be accessible to novice players yet also compelling for more experienced gamers. This is a standalone game in a small box, not an expansion (the birds in it are not compatible with Wingspan). Wingspan Pocket features birds from around the world.

Components

  • 2 rulebooks (multiplayer and solo)
  • 5 Nest cards (57x87mm)
  • 5 player aids (80x120mm)
  • 1 first-player card (57x87mm)
  • 106 double-sided bird/food cards (57x87mm)
  • 60 egg tokens
  • 5 player tokens
  • 1 goal display
  • 9 double-sided goal cards (44x67mm)
  • 11 Automa cards and 1 solo Nest card
  • 1 box (110x160x50mm)
